text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a big holiday night, and I can hear bells ringing from somewhere outside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Happy Holi… halluci… I'm hallucinating…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-not yet, but I think I'm getting there…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite it being a festive occasion, Ryan has a pained expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is coming up… All the top racers are going to be there…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And it'll be Oguri's last race. She's really strong to begin with, but she'll be extra determined to close things out with a huge win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: On top of that, all the racing fans in the country are gonna be rooting for her to win…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I have to beat her and take victory for myself, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've gotten used to pressure from my races against McQueen, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: This is something totally different. The muscles in my heart feel sore, like I've been readin' too many romance mangas…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to really be struggling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There's only one thing to do… Let's throw a pity party for ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: We can eat a ton of carbs, dance till we drop, and forget about all our worries!
choice_data_list: I… I don't think that'll help.
I… I don't think that'll help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I can't do this! My heart weights are too heavy to lift!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Come on! Let's get in that "hustle your muscle" spirit! Hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, as our very unhealthy party is about to begin…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who could that be? It's kinda late.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello-lo, Ryan! Been a while! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-Ines?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I thought you were resting at the recovery center. Did you… come to check up on me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Ines Fujin, Ryan's roommate who ran in the Japanese Derby with her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I get it. So that's why you were about to pig out on all this food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah. Even if I beat the top superstar, Oguri, it just won't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I get where you're coming from, but are you sure it's really like that?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I think everyone has their own pick for who they want to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: They each have favorites?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Right now I'm taking a break and doing rehab at a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But when I see you working so hard, it makes me want to return to racing as soon as I can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Seeing all the effort you gave when we ran in the Derby made me feel like I wanted to push harder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I like Oguri a lot, but my favorite star… is you, Ryan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I really want to see you win, so count that as one girl who's rooting for your victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You've got me, and you've also got your trainer. Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Geez, guys…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After leaving some heartfelt words and a gift of hot spring buns, Ines heads back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I understand I was wrong now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I was so blinded by Oguri's brilliance I couldn't see myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I'm a star too! And there are people out there who wanna see me shine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm carryin' the same weight as Oguri. That's why I have to…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm gonna win at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll show everyone by crushing both the Takarazuka and Arima Grand Prix races!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll show everyone by crushing both the Takarazuka and Arima Grand Prix races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are others, too, fervently rooting for Mejiro Ryan to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the—what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hi! I've been a member of your fan club since I was little!

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan B
text_block_list.text: Do your best! We'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wait, who's that person next to you? What are you two doing tonight on the holiday?

text_block_list.name: Ryan Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you about to celebrate together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh, well… It's not like that! We were just about to…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-never mind. No comment on that! …You can direct all other questions to my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Geez, I forgot you were right here! Please don't tell them anything from our talk earlier!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ryan's popularity has grown large enough for it to hamper her private life, just like Oguri Cap.
